# `em select repository create`

- **Usage:** `em select repository create <NAME> [LOCATION]`

Create a new local overlay (skeleton + repos.conf entry)

## Arguments
- **`<NAME>`** — Repository name
- **`[LOCATION]`** — Location (default: `<config-root>/var/db/repos/<name>`)

## Flags
- **`-h --help`** — Print help

## Output Formats

- **`json`** — Machine-parsable JSON (`--json` with `-p` or `--info`)

  **Framing:** `json`
